blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We investigate how frozen pretrained visual and depth representations support dense optical flow when coupled with a supervised matching network. Building on TTSFlow, this paper studies Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) feature decoding and one coarse-to-fine refinement stage. Our method fuses features from frozen DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 models and estimates optical flow through a trainable transformer-based matching pipeline. After optical-flow training on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings3D, it achieves 2.37 endpoint error (EPE) on the Sintel training split, Final pass, compared with 2.52 for the FlowSeek (T) configuration reported here. Our RoCo-Spring 2026 entry, RoCo-29.VSAI, obtains a robustness-balanced score of 1.1038, Spring EPE of 1.411, and RobustSpring proxy EPE of 4.739, with a lower balanced score than seven of the twelve listed reference baselines. These results characterize the complete pipeline, which reuses frozen foundation backbones and performs one refinement stage. Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}
blocks.zh: 我们调查了在结合一个有监督的匹配网络时,被冻结的先入为主的视觉和深度表现如何支持密集的光学流动。 本文以TTSFlow为基础,研究了Dense President Transformer(DPT)特征解码和一粗到精细的完善阶段. 我们的方法从被冻结的DINOv2和深度Anything V2模型中导出特性,并估计出光学流经可发式变压器相配管. 在飞行会长和飞行Things3D的光学流线训练后,在Sintel训练分出"最终通"上实现了2.37个端点出错(EPE),而本文所报告的"FlowSeek (T)"配置则达到了2.52个端点出错. 罗可春2026入场 罗可-29入场. VSAI,获得稳健平衡分数为1.1038分,春ESPE为1.411分,而RobustSpring代理ESE为4.739分,平衡分数低于所列出的12个参考基线中的7个. 这些成果是整个管道的特点,它重新使用被冻结的地基骨干,并进行一个改进阶段。 代码见:\url{https://github.com/Visual-and-Spatial-AI-Lab/FFlow}

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dense optical flow lies at the core of visual perception [ 43 ] . It estimates a motion vector for every pixel between consecutive frames. It enables a wide range of applications, including video understanding [ 8 ] , saliency detection [ 21 ] , action recognition [ 62 , 33 , 45 ] , dense 3D reconstruction [ 25 , 19 , 36 ] , and motion modeling [ 11 ] . Over the past decade, deep learning-based approaches have dramatically improved the accuracy of optical flow [ 4 , 5 , 9 , 12 , 20 , 24 , 39 , 40 , 42 , 44 , 46 , 47 , 52 , 53 , 55 , 63 , 61 ] . Notable methods such as RAFT [ 47 ] and its variants [ 51 , 12 , 34 ] combine learned representations with repeated flow updates. This motivates studying how pretrained representations can be used within an alternative matching pipeline.
blocks.zh: 腾讯光学流位于视觉感知的核心[43]. 它估计每个像素在相接相框之间的运动向量. 它可以实现广泛的应用,包括视频理解[8],显要检测[21],动作识别[62,33,45],密集的立体重建[25,19,36],运动模型[11]. 过去十年来,以深入学习为主的方针,大大提高了光学流的准确性[4,5,9,12,20,24,39,40,42,44,46,47,52,53,55,63,61]. RAFT[47]等著名方法及其变体[51,12,34]将所学表现与反复流更新相结合. 这促使人们研究如何在替代匹配管道内使用经过预先培训的表述。

blocks.en: In parallel, vision foundation models have reshaped the field of computer vision [ 31 , 2 , 17 , 35 , 7 ] . Models trained once on internet-scale imaging data now transfer effectively across computer vision tasks such as object detection [ 64 ] , segmentation [ 60 ] , depth estimation [ 57 , 58 ] , and geometric reasoning [ 22 ] . Rather than retraining specialized architectures for each problem, we increasingly reuse pretrained representations as general-purpose visual priors. These developments motivate reusing pretrained representations while learning the modules needed for optical-flow estimation.
blocks.zh: 同时,视觉基础模型重塑了计算机视觉领域[31,2,17,35,7]. 曾经接受过互联网成像数据培训的模型现在有效地跨越了计算机的视觉任务,例如物体探测[64]、分块[60]、深度估计[57,58]和几何推理[22]。 我们不再对每个问题进行再培训,而是越来越多地将预先培训过的表述作为通用视觉前身加以再利用。 这些发展促使人们在学习光学流估计所需的模块的同时,重新使用预先训练过的表示。

blocks.en: Pretrained representations have also been investigated for optical flow, including cross-view pretraining in CroCo v2 [ 53 ] , depth-informed estimation in FlowSeek [ 34 ] , and pretrained input encoders in WAFT [ 50 ] . Our question is how to combine frozen visual and depth representations within a dense optical-flow pipeline. We evaluate that pipeline on cross-dataset optical-flow benchmarks and the RoCo-Spring corruption benchmark. Appendix C discusses these approaches and the related video-based reconstruction setting of D4RT [ 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 还调查了对光学流的预先训练的表示,包括CroCo v2 [53]中的交叉视图预训,FlowSeek [34]中的深度知情估计,以及WAFT中预先训练的输入编码器 [50]. 我们的问题是,如何在密集的光流管道中将被冻结的视觉和深度表现结合起来。 我们对跨数据集光学流动基准和RoCo-Spring腐败基准的管道进行评估。 附 录 C讨论了这些方法以及相关的基于视频的D4RT重建设置[59].

blocks.en: This paper extends our TTSFlow framework [ 3 ] , retaining its combination of frozen DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 features before matching. The changes studied here are DPT-based decoding of intermediate DINOv2 features, one higher-resolution refinement stage, and evaluation of a Spring-adapted model on RoCo-Spring. The matching transformer, correlation-to-flow formulation, feature-based propagation, coarse-to-fine refinement, and convex upsampling follow GMFlow [ 55 ] . These are inherited components, not new matching operators. The downstream transformer, projection and fusion layers, propagation projections, and upsampling predictor are learned from optical-flow supervision. Experiment (Table 5 ) compares DPT configurations at a fixed refinement count. The historical TTSFlow fusion ablation is explicitly identified in the experiments (Table 4 ). Our experimental results evaluate this combined system rather than isolating what frozen foundation features can achieve alone.
blocks.zh: 本文扩展了我们的TTSFlow框架[3],在匹配前保留了被冻结的DINOv2和深度任意V2特性的组合. 这里所研究的变化有:基于DPT的中间 DINov2 特性的解码,一个更高分辨率的完善阶段,以及在RoCo-Spring上对一个"泉"适应模型的评价. 相匹配的变压器,相对流配制,以特征为主的传播,粗细的到精细的改进,和对流的上下取样跟随GMFlow [55]. 这些是继承的组件,而不是新的匹配运算符. 下游变压器、投影和聚变层、传播预测和上下取样预测器是从光学-流监督学来的。 实验(表5)在固定的完善计数中比较了DPT配置. 实验中明确确定了历史上的TTSFlow聚变衰竭(表4)。 我们的实验结果评价了这个综合系统,而不是孤立了被冻结的地基特征能够单独实现的.

blocks.en: 5. Refinement and Final Upsampling. Following GMFlow [ 55 ] , we bilinearly upsample the propagated 1 / 8 1/8 flow by two and multiply its displacements by two. The detached flow warps the second-frame fused 1 / 4 1/4 features. The shared transformer processes the first-frame and warped second-frame features. Local matching in a 9 × 9 9\times 9 neighborhood predicts a residual added to the up-sampled flow. Propagation then uses a 3 × 3 3\times 3 neighborhood. blocks.en: 4 Conclusion, Limitations, and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 4. 结论、限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: We presented a foundation-driven optical flow framework that reuses frozen visual and depth foundation representations for dense correspondence estimation. By combining semantic and geometric priors through lightweight fusion and global matching, our method estimates optical flow in a single forward pass without expensive multi-step test-time refinement, achieving strong cross-dataset generalization and competitive accuracy. The main limitation here is that foundation features are not optimized specifically for optical flow. Consequently, the model may provide inferior results under extreme motion, severe appearance changes, occlusions, or fine motion boundaries. Lightweight multiple refinement, adaptive correction, or multi-frame temporal reasoning could improve robustness while preserving the efficiency of the proposed design. Broadly, this work points toward reducing task-specific training and test-time scaling in dense visual perception. Such approaches may benefit robotics, video understanding, and 3D scene analysis, but optical flow failures in safety-critical settings still require careful validation and uncertainty-aware deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个由基础驱动的光学流框架,重新利用被冻结的视觉和深度基础表示来进行密集的通信估计。 通过将语义学和几何学前科通过轻量级聚变和全球比对相结合,我们的方法估计光学流入单向前行,没有昂贵的多步试验时间精度,实现强跨数据集通俗化和有竞争力的精度. 这里的主要局限在于基础特征没有专门为光学流而优化. 因此,在极端运动、严重外观变化、被隔离或运动界限细小的情况下,模型可能提供低等结果。 轻而易举的多重改进、适应性修正或多框架时间推理可以提高稳健性,同时保持拟议设计的效率。 从广义上讲,这项工作指向减少针对特定任务的培训和在高密度视觉感知中的试验时间。 这种方法可能有利于机器人、视频理解和三维场景分析,但安全关键环境下的光学流出故障仍然需要认真验证和对不确定性的认识部署。

blocks.en: Appendix C Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录C 工作

blocks.en: (i) Learning-based Optical Flow. Early works such as FlowNet [ 6 ] introduced supervised regression, while PWC-Net [ 44 ] incorporated pyramidal cost volumes and warping to improve efficiency and accuracy. Subsequent approaches refined these ideas through multi-scale processing and architectural optimization. RAFT [ 47 ] established a dominant paradigm by formulating optical flow as iterative refinement over all-pairs correlations. Its recurrent update operator progressively corrects flow estimates, improving accuracy at the cost of increased inference time. SEA-RAFT [ 51 ] further optimized it, introducing probabilistic supervision and rigid-motion pretraining to improve efficiency and generalization, while [ 16 ] focused on speed and reduced memory needs. Despite these advances, RAFT and SEA-RAFT rely on multi-step test-time refinement to gain performance.
blocks.zh: (一) 以学习为基础的光学流动。 FlowNet等早期的作品[6]引入了有监督的回归,而PWC-Net [44] 则包含了金字塔成本量和扭曲来提高效率和准确性. 随后的方法通过多尺度的处理和建筑优化来完善这些想法. RAFT[47]通过将光学流作为全相间关联的迭接完善来形成一个主导范式. 它的经常性更新操作员逐渐地校正了流量估计值,以增加推论时间为代价提高了准确性. SEA-RAFT [51] 进一步优化了它,引入了概率监管和刚性运动预训以提高效率和通俗化,而 [16] 则专注于速度和减少内存需要. 尽管取得了这些进步,RAFT和SEA-RAFT依靠多步骤的测试时间改进来获得性能.

blocks.en: Transformer-based models such as GMFlow [ 55 ] and FlowFormer [ 12 ] shifted attention toward global reasoning. GMFlow presented optical flow as a global matching problem using attention and softmax normalization, yet requires supervised training and, in practice, benefits greatly from refinement. FlowFormer [ 12 ] extended this idea via cost-volume transformers to model long-range dependencies. Our pipeline inherits GMFlow’s transformer, correlation-to-flow formulation, propagation, refinement, and convex upsampling. It replaces the CNN feature extraction path with fused foundation-model features while retaining supervised training of the downstream flow-estimation modules.
blocks.zh: GMFlow[55]和FlowFormer[12]等基于变形器的模型将注意力转向了全球推理. GMFlow将光学流动视为一个全球性的匹配问题,它利用了注意力和软马克斯正常化,但需要接受有监督的培训,并且在实践中从改进中大大受益。 FlowFormer [12]通过成本-量变压器将这一想法扩展至模型长距离依赖. 我们的输油管继承了GMFlow的变压器、对流相通配制、传播、精炼和凸起式提升。 它将CNN的特性提取路径取而代之的是已引信的地基模型特性,同时保留下游流-估计模块的监督培训.

blocks.en: (ii) Geometric Priors in Optical Flow. Incorporating geometric cues into optical flow has long been an attractive direction [ 43 , 54 ] . Earlier methods relied on piecewise rigid motion assumptions [ 49 , 56 ] , whereas recent learning-based approaches inject depth priors directly into the network. Recently proposed FlowSeek [ 34 ] represents an interesting step in this direction. It integrates monocular depth foundation models [ 58 ] into a RAFT-style architecture and demonstrates improved cross-dataset generalization. FlowSeek uses depth features and depth-derived motion bases in a recurrent flow-estimation architecture. We instead fuse an intermediate Depth Anything V2 decoder feature with a separate DINOv2 feature stream before correlation-based matching. The foundation models remain fixed, while the downstream transformer and flow-estimation modules learn from optical-flow supervision. This distinction concerns where pretrained features enter the matching pipeline; it does not remove flow-specific learning.
blocks.zh: (二) 光流中的几何前传。 将几何入入入光学流长期以来是一个有吸引力的方向[43,54]. 更早的方法依赖于片面刚性运动假设[49,56],而最近的以学习为基础的方法直接将深度前缀注入网络. 最近提出的FlowSeek[34]是朝这个方向迈出的令人感兴趣的一步。 它将单相通深度地基模型[58]整合入RAFT风格的架构并展示出改进了的跨数据集通论. FlowSeek在经常性的流量估计架构中使用了深度特征和深度衍生的运动基. 相反,我们在基于相关性的匹配之前,将一个中间深度 Anything V2 解码器特性与单独的 DINOv2 特性流相连接。 地基模型保持不变,而下游变压器和流量估计模块则从光学-流量监督中学习. 这种区分涉及预先训练的特性进入匹配管道的情况;它不会去除针对流量的学习.

blocks.en: (iii) Vision Foundation Models for Dense Geometry. Vision foundation models have recently demonstrated remarkable transferability across tasks. Self-supervised models such as DINO [ 2 ] and DINO-v2 [ 31 ] learn dense, semantically meaningful representations that generalize across domains without explicit supervision. In parallel, depth foundation models such as Depth Anything [ 57 ] and its successors [ 58 ] achieve strong cross-dataset generalization and produce boundary-aware geometric predictions. Dense prediction architectures such as the Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) [ 37 ] further bridge the gap between transformer token representations and spatially structured outputs. DPT-style decoders reassemble intermediate transformer features into multi-scale dense maps, enabling tasks that require fine-grained spatial reasoning. Our visual DPT head decodes intermediate DINOv2 features before they are resampled to the global-matching and refinement grids. It is distinct from the pretrained DPT decoder inside Depth Anything V2. Figure 1 and Appendix G.1 specify both paths, including the exact depth-decoder feature used.
blocks.zh: (三) 地心几何远景基础模型。 远景基础模型最近显示出不同任务之间的显著可转移性。 DINO[2]和DINO-v2[31]等自我监督的模型学习了密集的,精密有意义的表达方式,这些表达方式在没有明确监督的情况下在各个领域中泛泛而论. 同时,深度Anything等深度基础模型[57]及其后继模型[58]实现强跨数据集通论并产生有边界意识的几何预测. Dense President Transformer (DPT)等感知预测架构 [37] 进一步弥合了变速器符号表示和空间结构输出之间的差距. DPT风格的解码器将可分解的中间变速器特征重新组装成多尺度的稠密地圖,使能任务需要精细的空间推理. 我们的视觉 DPT 头解码中间 DINOv2 特性 在它们被重印到全局匹配和完善格网之前。 它不同于深度Anything V2内部预先训练的DPT解码器. 图1和附录G.1指定了两条路径,包括所使用的精确深度解码功能.

blocks.en: Direct predecessor and other pretrained architectures. TTSFlow [ 3 ] is the direct predecessor of this submission: it already combines frozen DINOv2 and depth-foundation features, fusion, and global matching. Here we study DPT-based visual decoding, one higher-resolution refinement stage, and a Spring-adapted RoCo-Spring entry. The TTSFlow rows in Tables 1 and 2 , and the fusion ablation in Table 4 , reproduce the predecessor’s reported results rather than new evaluations of the submitted configuration.
blocks.zh: 直接前身和其他预训建筑. TTSFlow [3] 是本提交材料的直接前身:它已经结合了被冻结的DINOv2和深度建立特性,聚变,以及全局匹配. 在这里,我们研究了基于DPT的视觉解码,一个高分辨度的完善阶段,以及一个被"春"适应的RoCo-Spring条目. 表1和表2中的TTSFlow行和表4中的聚变衰减,转载了前任报告的结果,而不是对所提交的配置的新评价。

blocks.en: WAFT [ 50 ] uses frozen pretrained input encoders, including Depth Anything V2 and DINOv3 variants, with high-resolution warping and recurrent updates instead of a cost volume. Thus, pretrained encoders are not unique to our method. Our configuration combines two distinct frozen feature streams and uses explicit global correlation followed by one local residual update. CroCo v2 [ 53 ] pretrains a transformer through cross-view completion and adapts it to stereo matching and optical flow. Its cross-view pretraining differs from reusing the separately pretrained visual and monocular-depth models studied here. D4RT [ 59 ] uses a feed-forward video representation with spatiotemporal queries for dynamic 3D reconstruction and tracking. It provides a related example of unified geometric prediction, whereas our evaluated task is two-frame dense 2D optical flow. These are architectural comparisons; no training-matched accuracy comparison with WAFT, CroCo v2, or D4RT is reported here.
blocks.zh: WAFT [50] 使用被冻结的预先训练的输入编码器,包括深度Anything V2和DINOv3等变体,具有高分辨的扭曲和经常性更新,而不是成本量. 因此,预训编码器不是我们的方法所独有的. 我们的配置结合了两条明显的被冻结的地物流,并使用明确的全球相关性,然后是局部的剩余更新. CroCo v2 [53]通过横视完成预接变压器,并适应立体匹配和光学流. 其跨视前训练不同于在此所研究的分别使用被先训练的视觉和单相深度模型. D4RT [59] 使用向导视频表示,并带有spatiental查询,用于动态3D重建与跟踪. 它提供了一个统一的几何预测的相关例子,而我们所评价的任务则是两帧密集的2D光学流. 这些是建筑方面的比较;这里没有报告与WAFT、CroCo v2或D4RT的训练相匹配的准确性比较。

Specifically, we evaluate three configurations.
(i) Depth-only : the DINOv2 backbone and the cross-modal fusion module are removed, leaving only depth features for correspondence estimation.
(ii) DINO-only : the depth encoder, depth projection module, and fusion module are removed, leaving only semantic features from DINOv2.
(iii) Depth + DINOv2 : the full representation combining semantic and geometric priors.
All variants use the no-DPT, zero-refinement configuration. These component-removal results are distinct from independently training an otherwise matched single-branch model; they do not isolate the information intrinsically available in either encoder.

(一)只有深度:DINov2主干线和跨模式聚变模块被去除,只剩下深度特性用于函证估计.

blocks.en: G.2 Frozen Parameters, Gradient Paths, and Counts

blocks.en: Both pretrained foundation models are frozen. The public constructor loads DINOv2-S from the Hugging Face model and Depth Anything V2-B from the supplied depth checkpoint. The downstream transformer, depth projections, fusion, propagation projections, and upsampling predictor participate in flow-loss backpropagation. The matching transformer, propagation, and convex upsampling follow GMFlow; the depth projections and feature fusion follow the TTSFlow design. Architectural provenance does not, by itself, imply initialization from a pretrained GMFlow optical-flow checkpoint. The released constructor does not load such a checkpoint; subsequent --resume loads the specified FFlow state.

blocks.en: The public FFlow.forward wraps the entire dino_extract_feature call in torch.no_grad() . That call includes the added visual DPT head as well as the frozen DINOv2 encoder. Thus, although the visual DPT parameters have requires_grad=True , the released forward path does not produce flow-loss gradients for them. Their initial values come from the layer constructors unless overwritten by a resumed FFlow state; no separate pretrained visual-DPT checkpoint is loaded there. This distinction must be resolved against the training snapshot before attributing the reported DPT comparison to a flow-trained visual decoder. Merely counting parameters with requires_grad=True would overstate the gradient-connected portion of this release.

blocks.en: The released defaults use AdamW with weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient-norm clipping at 1, and seed 326. The OneCycle learning-rate scheduler uses the stage’s peak rate, a 5% increasing portion, cosine decay, and no momentum cycling. The Things stage combines its Clean and Final renders. The TSKH dataset concatenates 100 × 100\times Sintel Clean, 100 × 100\times Sintel Final, 200 × 200\times KITTI, 5 × 5\times HD1K, and one copy of Things Clean. These are dataset-repeat factors, not per-step batch quotas.

blocks.en: The training augmentors use random paired crops, not center crops. The same sampled crop is applied to the two images, the flow, and applicable validity information. Spatial resizing also rescales horizontal and vertical flow components. Dense-data crops sample a valid origin after spatial augmentation; the sparse KITTI augmentor samples with vertical/horizontal margins of 20/50 pixels and clips to valid origins, so its distribution is not the same uniform crop distribution. The Spring augmentor has its own padding, resizing, and random-crop procedure. In the released dataset definitions, the log 2 resize ranges are [ − 0.1 , 1.0 ] [-0.1,1.0] for Chairs, [ − 0.4 , 0.8 ] [-0.4,0.8] for Things, [ − 0.2 , 0.6 ] [-0.2,0.6] for TSKH’s Things/Sintel components, [ − 0.3 , 0.5 ] [-0.3,0.5] for its KITTI component, [ − 0.5 , 0.2 ] [-0.5,0.2] for HD1K, [ − 0.2 , 0.4 ] [-0.2,0.4] for KITTI-only adaptation, and [ − 1.0 , − 0.8 ] [-1.0,-0.8] for Spring. The augmentors also enforce crop-size feasibility; these ranges alone do not specify the realized scale distribution. KITTI-only adaptation disables flips.

blocks.en: The main tables distinguish cross-dataset evaluation from adaptation to datasets subsequently evaluated on their training splits. Predictions, not model weights, are submitted to the challenge server. The public entry identifies the reported benchmark outputs, but the supplied release does not by itself establish the challenge checkpoint hash, inference resizing/padding command, or final unpadding procedure used for that entry. We do not infer those settings from training crop sizes or from the feature-branch input sizes.
